name: Solace System
description: A mature trade system centred on Solace II and a dense orbital and surface industrial network.
history: Solace grew from a logistics waypoint into one of the region's principal commercial manufacturing systems after propulsion and alloy industries established permanent facilities around Solace II.
visualDescription: A warm yellow primary with a busy inner commercial zone and dense orbital traffic around Solace II.

image.promptDescription: Wide astronomical view of a prosperous yellow-star commercial system, with a busy temperate industrial world and visible orbital infrastructure.

name: Varda System
description: A quieter system known for controlled-environment agriculture, bioscience campuses and food-security research serving remote colonies.
history: Varda became a specialist research system after sealed agricultural campuses proved valuable to long-duration colony programmes.
visualDescription: A soft orange star illuminating a cool oceanic primary world, with sparse traffic and clean scientific infrastructure.

image.promptDescription: Wide astronomical view of a calm orange-star research system with a cool oceanic world and restrained scientific orbital infrastructure.
